item.title: Press Release: Response to the statement made by the Guyana Teachers’ Union

item.title: ‘We invest in people, not just projects’ – President Ali at Bayroc Stadium opening
item.description: President Dr Mohamed Irfaan Ali on Saturday said the opening of the Bayroc Track and Field Stadium at Wismar, Linden, represents not only an investment in sport but in opportunity, unity, and economic growth for Region Ten.
